scope: Independently accepted artifact delivery and fresh repository outcome verification through the external broker
implemented: Formal v2 Goal admission consumes an existing exact externalGrantId without issuing a broker grant or requesting a Host credential. Generated Policy authorizes scoped tools, trusted background execution, finite scheduling and original-owner notices.

Accepted artifact bytes are committed through signed UDS, then an explicitly authorized fixed head/base PR is created. Host handoff storage retains signed history without artifact bytes; credential and authoritative action journal stay in the broker.

Repository outcome readback reconstructs the signed payload from current accepted artifacts, verifies commit/PR receipts and fetches current branch, PR, checks and reviews. Owner, grant, generation and epoch fences reject stale or mixed observations.

Ledger v1 to v2 migration preserves all historical grants, unknown outcomes and consumed budgets. Commit dispatch and PR occupancy reject a new key around an unresolved action, including grant revision changes; reads remain possible.

earlierFailures.cause: Migration budget negative fixture used the same head as an unresolved commit, so the new conflict guard rejected before the expected budget error. Changed only the test head; final combined 61-test suite passed.
Initial setup used inherited user Skills database default; test now preconfigures private fixture paths. Its log was overwritten by the second attempt; no log hash is claimed.
Private state fixed the initial rejection, then global DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 activation timed out.

Retained-host diagnosis identified incompatible global session-persistence 0.1.5-rc.2, missing the event-support oracle. Test uses independently installed pinned CLI; release installation compatibility is being tightened.

The first real run independently completed repair/commit/PR, but the fixture returned repository DTO for file inspection. Corrected file response and retained strict successful-read assertions. Review also found private broker receipt fields exposed by inspect; fixed explicit public projection and added a real signed-socket regression. Final complete E2E passed.

limitations: Local integration uses real UDS, Ed25519, SQLite, Core and protected test token files, with injected GitHub transports and same-UID peer fixtures; no live GitHub write, remote CI/review result or independent-UID deployment is claimed.
External branch creation, compensation and repository event polling remain unsupported. The operator provisions daemon identity, keys, credentials and authoritative grants.
Historical signed receipts prove bound broker history, not current authorization or remote freshness. Key rotation can make historical verification unavailable.
Unknown or interrupted writes never automatically replay. PR creation lacks a remote atomic expected-head CAS; mismatched acknowledgement remains unknown.
